_note: Hand-chosen Commons files, used instead of the species' Wikidata image (P18) when that image cannot be used: a licence outside CC0 / public domain / CC BY / CC BY-SA (rule 8), or an author the credit cannot name. The build still checks each file's licence and reads its credit from Commons.

Equus caballus.why: Wikidata image uses the Commons 'Attribution' licence, not one of the four allowed

Danio rerio.why: Wikidata image is 'Copyrighted free use', not one of the four allowed

Pipistrellus pipistrellus.why: Wikidata image is CC BY-SA with an unknown author, so the attribution it requires cannot be given

Neoceratodus forsteri.why: Wikidata image is CC BY-SA with an unknown author
